Ockhi (2017) - Kerala, Luban (2018) - Arabian Peninsula (Yemen/Oman), Titli (2018) - Andhra Pradesh; only code (2) fits, leaving Gaja - Somalia, although Gaja actually hit Tamil Nadu (Nagapattinam) and Somalia was hit by Cyclone Sagar (May 2018).

notes.text: - APPSC G1 2018 match: Ockhi – Kerala, Luban – Arabian Peninsula, Titli – AP (the paper put Gaja against Somalia; Somalia was hit by Cyclone **Sagar**, May 2018).

exam: APPSC Group-III Panchayat Secretary Mains Paper-I General St
q: How many of the 130 Cyclones that hit the coast of Andhra pradesh during the past one century were treated as most severe?
explanation:
No printed key and no source gives the '130 cyclones' figure; keyed 31 from IMD's count of severe cyclonic storms hitting AP (1891-2017).
IMD records show 31 severe cyclonic storms (47 knots or more) crossing the Andhra Pradesh coast in 1891-2017 out of all storms and depressions; 31 is the matching figure among the options.

notes.text: - IMD record 1891–2017: AP coast hit **77 times** by cyclones (34 kt+), **31 of them severe** cyclonic storms.

exam: APPSC Assistant Motor Vehicle Inspector 2023
q: India has a coastline of about 7516 kms, which is exposed to nearly ....... per cent of the world's tropical cyclones.
explanation: India's coast is exposed to nearly 10% of the world's tropical cyclones (NDMA).

notes.text: - India's coast is exposed to nearly **10%** of the world's tropical cyclones (APPSC-GS 2023; NDMA). Coastline: old **7,516.6 km**; remeasured 2023–24 = **11,098.81 km**; about 5,900 km directly exposed.

exam: APPSC Sample Taker 2023
q: ____ was the first Indian city directly hit by cyclone Hudhud in 2014.
explanation: Hudhud (Oct 2014) made landfall at Visakhapatnam, the first Indian city directly hit by a cyclone of that strength.

exam: APPSC Asst. B.C. Welfare Officers, Royalty Inspector
q: Which Indian state was worst hit by 'Extremely Severe Cyclonic Storm Fani' in the year 2019?
explanation: Extremely Severe Cyclonic Storm Fani (May 2019) hit Puri, Odisha; about 1.2 million people were evacuated.

exam: APPSC Polytechnic Lecturers 2020 (15-03-2020)
q: Which of the following was the most devastating natural disaster that affected India in 2019?
explanation: Cyclone Fani (May 2019) was the year's most devastating disaster in India, hitting Odisha with huge damage despite the big evacuation.

exam: APPSC Polytechnic Lecturers 2020 (13-03-2020)
q: The Regional Integrated Multi-Hazard Early Warning System (RIMES) for Africa and Asia, a 45-nation international organisation on disaster warning, has termed ____, the severe cyclonic storm that devastated Odisha in October 2018, as 'rarest cyclone'.
explanation: RIMES called Cyclone Titli (Oct 2018) the 'rarest' cyclone: after landfall it recurved inland into south Odisha, keeping its destructive force for over two days and causing landslides.
